StoryboardProject.title: StoryboardProject
StoryboardProject.description: A user-owned AI filmmaking and storyboard project with story script, language, genre, and episode metadata.

logline.description: Short cinematic premise or tagline (0-500 chars).

artStyle.description: Visual style for storyboard frames and prompts.

storyText.description: Full story manuscript text across episodes (0-25000 chars).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StoryboardScene.title: StoryboardScene
StoryboardScene.description: Individual shot-by-shot scene inside a storyboard project with camera directions, English image/video prompts, Hindi dialogue, voice-over, subtitles, and BGM/SFX cues.

description.description: Visual scene breakdown and staging description (0-3000 chars).

cameraMovement.description: Camera movement instructions for Google Flow (0-300 chars).

characterAction.description: Character blocking and motion cues (0-1000 chars).

imagePrompt.description: Detailed English image generation prompt (0-3000 chars).

consistencyNotes.description: Character and wardrobe consistency instructions (0-1000 chars).

dialogueCharacter.description: Speaking character name or Narrator (0-120 chars).

hindiDialogue.description: Hindi dialogue line for the scene (0-2000 chars).

voiceOverScript.description: Voice-over narration script and delivery notes (0-2000 chars).

subtitleText.description: Subtitle cue text for the scene (0-1000 chars).

bgmPrompt.description: Background music mood and instrumentation cue (0-500 chars).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CharacterProfile.title: CharacterProfile
CharacterProfile.description: Reusable Character Bible entry defining appearance, clothing, hairstyle, expressions, voice tone, and consistency token.

projectId.description: Optional linked project ID, or empty string for reusable studio-wide character (0-128 chars).

role.description: Story role such as Protagonist, Antagonist, Mentor (0-100 chars).

description.description: Character bio, facial features, and build (0-2000 chars).

hairstyle.description: Hair color, cut, and styling details (0-400 chars).

expressions.description: Key emotional expressions and mannerisms (0-600 chars).

consistencyToken.description: Reusable English prompt anchor to keep character appearance consistent across shots (0-1500 chars).

voiceTone.description: Voice casting and delivery tone for Hindi dialogue (0-200 chars).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SavedPrompt.title: SavedPrompt
SavedPrompt.description: Saved standalone Image Prompt, Google Flow Video Prompt, or Voice Script generated in Studio tools.

title.description: Prompt label or shot name (1-150 chars).

promptText.description: Full prompt or script content (1-5000 chars).

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio metadata such as 9:16, 16:9, or 1:1 (0-16 chars).

artStyle.description: Style or camera movement metadata (0-80 chars).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-scoped collection of AI storyboard filmmaking projects.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/sce.description: Shot-by-shot storyboard scenes nested under a user's project.

/users/{userId}/promptHistory/{promptId}.description: User-scoped archive of generated Image, Google Flow Video, and Voice prompts.
